skill.summary: FBS 福帮手长文档写作：书/手册/白皮书/长篇报道全流程；Node 脚本驱动 intake、会话恢复、S/P/C/B 质检与 MD/HTML 交付。用户提及写书、出书、章节、大纲、素材、质检、导出、扩写、退出保存时启用。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of fbs-bookwriter OpenClaw edition.

- Adds OpenClaw-specific SKILL.md, detailing installation, usage, and environment differences with WorkBuddy.
- Clean separation from WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy, with only OpenClaw-ready files included.
- Full workflow documentation: installation, script commands, error handling, and output/capability expectations.
- Provides quick-start, stage-gate workflow, and integration instructions for book writing in OpenClaw.
- Aligns asset/capability definitions with upstream project standards.
